# Block reference

All blocks are strict JSON objects with a `kind`. The canonical schemas are in `schema/` and
`core/schema.ts`. Every block may carry `source` (1–5 `{ "file", "page" }`).

| Kind | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [`prose`](prose.md) | Short explanatory text (at most 80 words) that connects the other blocks. |
| [`info`](info.md) | A callout: a note, an insight, a warning or a common pitfall the learner should not miss. |
| [`concepts`](concepts.md) | Show the lecture's defined concepts as cards. Every id must exist in the lecture's `concepts` list. |
| [`formula`](formula.md) | A formula worth remembering, in KaTeX syntax, with a caption that names the symbols. |
| [`code`](code.md) | A code or query example from the material. Set `run` only for SQL, Cypher or Gremlin that the site can execute. |
| [`table`](table.md) | Comparisons and structured facts: rows of items, columns of properties. |
| [`figure`](figure.md) | An image that is already in the content's figures/ folder. |
| [`steps`](steps.md) | A worked example or procedure with numbered steps, each with a short Markdown explanation. |
| [`timeline`](timeline.md) | Events or stages in time order, each with a label (date or stage) and a short text. |
| [`list`](list.md) | Learning objectives at the start of a lecture, or key takeaways at the end. |
| [`exercises`](exercises.md) | An exercise sheet from the material: several exercises, each with checked tasks and model solutions. |
| [`recall`](recall.md) | Flashcards for active recall: a prompt and its answer. |
| [`practice`](practice.md) | A few practice tasks with checks: `select` (choose from options), `text` (accepted answers) or `open` (self-checked against the solution). |
| [`widget`](widget.md) | An interactive widget from the widget catalogue; `props` must match that widget's schema. |

Prefer the smallest block that preserves the source's teaching purpose. Never use a widget as a
decoration and never put executable course logic in JSON.
